raw.title: Working Student - Network Planning (m/f/d)
raw.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We're looking for a motivated and driven Working Student - Network Planning (m/f/d) who will help us shape our team, drive the company to the next level, and have the most direct influence on our success. You will join our international Team Network Planning - Europe North & UK.

This position is part-time (20 hours per week), based in our Berlin office (hybrid model).

About the Role

  • Perform data entry, tracking, and validation across tools (Excel, Planr, Salesforce, backend systems, etc.), including regular data updates and quality checks
  • Support preparation of presentations, reports, analyses, and maps
  • Support the team in network planning activities in order to open sales and adapt our offer to transportation demand
  • Take meeting notes, clean up content, and provide concise summaries
  • Support the analysis of our network with various datasets and reports in order to continuously improve our service
  • Prepare important documentation for the authorization of new bus lines
  • Provide operational support throughout the annual timeline

About You

  • Enrolled student or graduate in Transportation Planning, Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, Urban Planning, Geography, Tourism or similar
  • You're passionate about the transportation sector and show a keen interest in schedule and network planning
  • Strong analytical skills, readiness of mind and a goal-driven personality
  • Fluent in English, all other European languages are considered as a plus
  • Accurate work style as well as strong communication skills
  • Skilled user of the MS Office programs, especially Word and Excel

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: AI Solution Architect (m/w/d)
description: Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unseres Customer Cluster Environment, Transportation & Energy. DEINE MISSION Als AI Solution Architect (m/w/d) gestaltest Du die KI-/ML-Gesamtarchitektur für komplexe Enterprise-Umgebungen in der Cloud mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure. Du verbindest fundiertes Know-how in ML Engineering, RAG-Architekturen und MLOps, um KI-Lösungen produktionsreif, skalierbar und sicher umzusetzen. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit technischen Expert:innen, Fachbereichen und Entscheidungsträgern zusammen und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, innovative KI-Lösungen erfolgreich zu etablieren. Deine Aufgaben: Entwurf und Weiterentwicklung der KI-/ML-Gesamtarchitektur als Enterprise-KI-Plattform mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure Technische Leitung von ML-Pipeline-Projekten, insbesondere in den Bereichen Training, Deployment, Monitoring und Drift Detection Konzeption und Optimierung von RAG-Architekturen, beispielsweise hinsichtlich Chunking, Retrieval, Guardrails und Context Orchestration Definition und Weiterentwicklung von MLOps-Strategien einschließlich CI/CD für Modelle, Experiment-Tracking und Model Registry Technische Führung und Koordination interdisziplinärer Teams aus ML/AI Engineers, LLM Engineers und MLOps Engineers Beratung interner und externer Stakeholder zu KI-Architekturen sowie Präsentation technischer Konzepte gegenüber IT-Leitung und Fachbereichen DAS IST UNS WICHTIG Fundierte Erfahrung mit cloudbasierten KI-/ML-Lösungen, idealerweise auf Microsoft Azure, insbesondere Azure Machine Learning und Azure OpenAI Service. Kenntnisse weiterer Cloud- und AI-Services sind von Vorteil. Praktische Erfahrung mit MLOps-Konzepten und entsprechenden Werkzeugen wie MLflow, Kubeflow oder Azure ML Pipelines. Erfahrung im Aufbau von RAG-Architekturen, Prompt Engineering und im Umgang mit Vektordatenbanken. Kenntnisse in der Integration und Orchestrierung von Sprachmodellen, idealerweise mit Frameworks wie LangChain oder LlamaIndex. Erfahrung mit CI/CD für ML-Anwendungen sowie sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse. Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens zwei gängigen Machine-Learning-Frameworks, beispielsweise scikit-learn, PyTorch oder TensorFlow. Erfahrung im Aufbau von Enterprise-Architekturen in Cloud-Umgebungen. Kenntnisse in angrenzenden Bereichen wie Datenplattformen, Containerisierung, Container-Orchestrierung, Infrastructure as Code und Observability sind von Vorteil, beispielsweise mit Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana oder Application Insights. Grundlegendes Verständnis von AI Governance, Responsible AI sowie Sicherheits- und Datenschutzanforderungen im Enterprise-Umfeld. Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit ML-/AI-Architekturen oder vergleichbaren technischen Aufgaben in Enterprise-Umgebungen. Erfahrung in einer technischen Leitungs- oder Architekturrolle ist wünschenswert. Azure-, AWS- oder Google-Cloud-Zertifizierungen sind ein Plus. Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Energiebranche oder Versorgungswirtschaft sowie mit datengetriebenen Anwendungsfällen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. DEIN NEUER ARBEITSPLATZ Was bei uns zählt? Klar definierte Rollen, echtes Miteinander und ein gemeinsames Ziel. Wir nennen das Responsiveness – transparent, wertschätzend und zielorientiert. Hier bist du am Wandel direkt beteiligt, wenn du möchtest. – Nimm Teil an Projekten, die uns als Unternehmen weiterentwickeln. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote Work? – Sind selbstverständlich. Individuelles Hardware-Budget? – Stell dir deinen Arbeitsplatz so zusammen, wie du dich am wohlsten fühlst. Mental Health? – Dein mentales Wohlbefinden ist uns wichtig. Mit OpenUp unterstützen wir dich und bieten dir jederzeit kostenlosen Zugang zu professioneller psychologischer Unterstützung. Individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget? – Egal ob die nächste Zertifizierung oder ein lang ersehnter Sprachkurs – du entscheidest, worin und wann du dich weiterbildest. Mitarbeiter:innen-PC-Programm? – Lease dir dein nächstes Device zur rein privaten Nutzung einfach über virtual7. JobRad oder Firmenwagen? – Wir helfen dir dabei, so mobil zu sein, wie du es brauchst. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Telnyx</strong></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a </span></em><a href="https://telnyx.com/our-network"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">private, global, multi-cloud IP network</span></em></a><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">, to bringing </span></em><a href="https://telnyx.com/resources/about-edge-connectivity"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">hyperlocal edge</span></em></a><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"> technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.</span></em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.</span></em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.</span></em></p></div><p data-start="3512" data-end="3596">&nbsp;</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <div id="message-list_1789158556.563599"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div><strong>The Role</strong><br><br>We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in Munich — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless.<br><br>This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale.<br><br>You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.<br><br><em>The Pod Model</em><br><br><em>Enterprise AE</em> — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account. .<br><br><em>Forward Deployed Engineer</em> — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.<br><br>We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.<br><br><strong>What You'll Do</strong><br><br>• Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand<br>• Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC<br>• Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models like Aleph Alpha's Luminous, or sovereign EU models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it<br>• Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys<br>• Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing<br>• Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't<br>• Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades<br>• Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both<br>• Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for German-language use cases and DACH-specific regulatory environments (GDPR, EU AI Act, German data localization)<br>• Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live<br>• Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable<br>• Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on field insights from Germany, Austria, and Switzerland<br>• Create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and maintainable solutions for handoff</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div id="message-list_1789158556.594389"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div>• Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues alongside customer teams<br><br><strong>What We're Looking For</strong><br><br>• CS degree or equivalent experience<br>• 3+ years building and shipping production software — you've written code that real users depended on, you've been on-call for it, and you've debugged it when things broke. (A consulting background counts if this is also true of you.)<br>• Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.)<br>• Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency<br>• Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story<br>• You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You know what to monitor, what to alert on, and what "healthy" looks like<br>• High-concurrency experience — Kafka, message queues, or event streams at real scale. When throughput spikes you know what breaks — consumer lag, backpressure, hot partitions, rebalance stalls — and what absorbs it: partitioning, consumer groups, parallelism up to your partition count<br>• You've built APIs from scratch, not just consumed them — OpenAPI spec, REST/GraphQL design, auth, rate limiting, versioning, idempotency<br>• Event-driven thinking and cloud-native instincts<br>• Exposure to SIP, WebRTC, or real-time voice/messaging systems<br>• Self-sufficient by default — there's no engineering team behind you. You read the code and the docs, ask the customer (not your manager), and make sound engineering judgment calls on your own<br>• Customer-facing engineering experience — you can run discovery with a customer's engineers and present to their executives in the same week<br>• Ability to translate "it's not working" into root cause<br>• Comfortable working on customer sites and in high-stakes technical conversations<br>• Excellent written and verbal communication in English and German. You can run whiteboard sessions, live troubleshooting, and escalations with customer engineering teams.<br>• Based in Munich, or willing to relocate — this is a hybrid role with travel across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland<br>• Legally authorized to work in Germany, or eligible for sponsorship<br><br><em>Bonus Points For</em><br><br>• Experience with AI voice assistants, STT/TTS, or LLM-based conversational systems<br>• Building eval sets for a specific domain<br>• Hands-on production experience with an LLM gateway — LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway, or an in-house OpenAI-compatible proxy — including config-driven model definitions, routing and fallback rules, and virtual key management<br>• Familiarity with the open-weight model landscape and the trade-offs between regional and multilingual models, including EU sovereign AI initiatives (Gaia-X, Aleph Alpha, European LLM projects)<br>• Experience with an inference serving engine behind the gateway — vLLM, SGLang, or TGI for production serving; Ollama for lightweight on-prem — and sizing GPU capacity for self-hosted models (KV-cache footprint, concurrent batch size, and context length against VRAM)<br>• SQL proficiency (Postgres, MySQL, Oracle)<br>• ETL and data wrangling experience<br>• CI/CD pipeline design and automation<br>• Background in telecom, CPaaS, or high-growth SaaS<br>• Experience with sovereign or on-prem cloud deployments and DACH regulatory frameworks (GDPR, EU AI Act, German data sovereignty and localization requirements, Swiss data protection)<br>• Security mindset (IAM, encryption, audit logging)</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <p><em>#LI-RH1</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

practices, standards, and documentation for AI content creation, and support colleagues in developing their AI capabilities.</li> <li>Stay closely connected to developments in generative AI, actively experimenting with new approaches and identifying opportunities to expand what the Studio can create.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years of professional description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners &nbsp;with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.</span><br><br></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">WHY JOIN US</span></strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&amp;D backing.</span></li> </ul></div><p><strong>ABOUT THE TEAM</strong></p> <p>The Data Operations team owns the entire data lifecycle behind STARK's AI stack: collection, acquisition, generation, curation, and management. We run our own data-collection campaigns across Europe, evaluate new sensors and platforms, and build the internal data platform that turns raw recordings into ready-to-use datasets. Everything we produce feeds directly into the perception and autonomy systems deployed on STARK's platforms — a real data advantage is built, not bought. The team is scaling up right now: real scope, direct impact, no legacy.</p> <p><strong>YOUR MISSION</strong></p> <p>You own our data-collection flights. When the perception team needs a specific dataset — a new camera at a new angle, a lidar over specific terrain, a thermal sensor at dusk — you plan the campaign, configure and tune the platform, fly the mission, and bring clean data home. Our hardware engineer builds the rigs and mounts, our robotics engineer makes the sensors record — you make it all fly, reliably, again and again. description: At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the German market. Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen. This role will assess Axle’s participation in German markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace. You speak German and fluent English. Other European languages are also an asset. What you will be doing Owning Axle’s commercial results in the German market: pipeline, revenue and partner success Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets. You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments. This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification. What’s in it for you This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience. We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. You’ll be based in the Germany. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the German market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in German markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak German and fluent English. Other European languages are also an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results in the German market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

  • Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

  • Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

  • Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

  • Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

  • Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in the Germany. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Werkzeuge, Schnittparameter und Spannstrategien für Aluminium, Stähle, Titan und Inconel auswählen. Toolpath-Bibliotheken, Programmiervorlagen und Dokumentation von Grund auf aufbauen. Maschinisten auf unsere Programmierstandards schulen, wenn das Team wächst. Was du mitbringst Fundierte CAM-Programmierung in Hypermill, Mastercam, Siemens NX oder vergleichbar. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit Toleranzen von ±0,01 mm oder enger. Erfahrung im Einrichten und Fahren von High-End-Maschinen wie Hermle oder DMG Mori: Du programmierst und fährst die Maschine selbst. Tiefes Verständnis von Vorschüben, Schnittgeschwindigkeiten, Werkzeugstrategie und Spanntechnik. Sicheres Lesen komplexer Zeichnungen und GD&T, saubere Dokumentation und Revisionsdisziplin. raw.description:
Your mission

About L1VE
L1VE is a growing media and technology company with offices in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K/3D/360° streaming technology and innovative live formats, we are changing the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.

Your Role

You are the voice of L1VE online. You build our social media from the ground up, take full ownership of it and work closely with our Content & Experience team. You report to the Head of Marketing & Sales. As the function grows, you can build your own team.

  • Full-time (5 days/week), project-based, 12 months
  • Work remotely within Europe or Asia, or on-site in Berlin

What You'll Do

  • Own all L1VE social media channels (Reddit, TikTok, Instagram, X; YouTube optional), incl. strategy, tone of voice and content calendar
  • Build and lead our own subreddit, our main place for talking with the community
  • Create platform-native short-form video (TikTok, Reels) that shows what it feels like to be there live with a VR headset, incl. ideas, scripts, editing and trend monitoring
  • Create content hands-on together with our content team
  • Manage community engagement across all channels, fast and in the L1VE voice
  • Create real-time content around our live events, optionally on site
  • Brief and manage freelancers, agencies, creators and on-site event partners, incl. quality control
  • Report on reach, engagement, follower growth and traffic, and feed learnings straight into the next content
  • Attend selected live events, including occasional international trips

Your profile

Must-have

  • 3–5 years of social media management experience for a brand, publisher, sports club, league or agency
  • A portfolio of your own posts, videos or campaigns with proven results
  • Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram: formats, algorithms, trends and internet culture
  • Hands-on short-form video skills: concept, shooting and editing (e.g. CapCut, Premiere)
  • Excellent written and spoken English (at least C1), German is a plus
  • Strong sense of ownership and a hands-on mentality: you build things from scratch and see them through

Nice-to-have

  • Experience working with freelancers or agencies
  • Practical experience with AI tools, ideally with concrete use cases
  • Data-driven approach using platform analytics
  • Experience with Reddit and its communities
  • Interest in sports, entertainment and immersive technology

Why us?

  • You work with live content from international sports and entertainment events that you won't find anywhere else.
  • You get plenty of creative freedom, short decision paths and flexible hours.

Interested?

Send us your CV, links to two or three posts or videos you're proud of, your day rate, and a few sentences on why you're a great fit for L1VE.

L1VE is committed to equal opportunities. We welcome applications regardless of origin, gender, age, religion, disability or sexual identity.

Contact person

Annette Hansen - Recruiting Manager

TL;DR

You know how to walk into an enterprise, spot the pain points in its ERP processes, and see what good could look like. Why Conduct

The world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the systems they run on. Today they don't, and you've seen why firsthand.

Every new product line, pricing change or process redesign runs into SAP estates layered with decades of custom code, user exits and enhancements no single person fully understands. Requirements take months to ship. S/4HANA migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain, and the 2027 ECC deadline is forcing every large enterprise to face it.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems. We've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

What you'll own

You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks inside our most strategic SAP customers. You join accounts early, shape how Conduct fits into their transformation programmes, and fully take over post-sale. You'll have a direct line from what you see in the field to what ships in the product.

  • Be the SAP brain in the room. Translate between CIOs, process owners, Basis teams and our engineers. Scope use cases across finance, supply chain, procurement and sales that land real value fast.

  • Design the transformation. Get under the skin of complex, heavily customised ECC and S/4HANA landscapes. Conceptualise where Conduct can have the biggest impact, then lead the deployment that gets the customer there.

  • Turn pilots into partnerships. Onboard hundreds of end users, prove ROI, spot expansion signals and hold the early commercial conversations that grow an account.

  • Shape the product. You'll have a direct line into product and engineering. Your view of how SAP actually runs in the real world will shape our roadmap.

  • Build the engine. Our GTM team is small and lean. You'll build the onboarding flows, tooling and reusable playbooks that let customer capacity compound without headcount growing linearly.

  • Work with our SI partners. You speak their language. Help partners deploy Conduct inside their own programmes.

No two days look the same. You'll fly out to customers when it counts and spend the rest of the time building alongside the team.

Who we hire

  • Real depth in at least one area of SAP. Functional (FI/CO, SD, MM, PP, EWM), technical (ABAP, integration, BTP) or solution architecture. You understand how processes and custom code fit together across the landscape.

  • Client-facing confidence. You've run workshops, owned a workstream and earned the trust of senior stakeholders who were sceptical at first.

  • Commercial instinct. You notice the next problem worth solving, and you understand that a great deployment is how accounts grow.

  • Builder energy. You want to do the hands-on customer work and build the process behind it. Ambiguity excites you more than it worries you.

  • Curiosity about AI. You don't need to be an engineer. You do need to want to learn how it works and where it breaks.

  • Low ego, high self-awareness. You're comfortable saying "I don't know" in a complex technical room, then going and figuring it out.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about trajectory and sharpness than a perfect match.

We don’t want a generic framework lifted from a larger, more traditional firm. You’ll take what we have, judge what’s working and what isn’t, and build it out where it needs to go next. You’ll also run it: pay reviews, benefits renewals, and the data and reporting that keep it trusted. You’ll refine it each cycle and make sure the framework is well documented and easy for others to work with. It suits someone who gets energy from building and improving, and who knows that reward only proves itself once it’s live. You’ll be comfortable with ambiguity and confident making judgement calls. You’ll respect what’s already been done while being willing to challenge it. You’ll also take satisfaction in the steady work of keeping a system accurate, fair and well-run. This is a role where one expert can own reward end to end, without needing a full-time seat. It will suit an experienced reward specialist who wants a senior, high-impact role with a bounded commitment, including people with a fractional or portfolio background who now want a permanent home. What you’ll own Reward strategy and philosophy: build on and evolve Unity’s approach to pay. That covers how we position against the market, how pay works across client-facing and enablement tracks, and how reward reinforces Unity’s “progress over process” culture rather than working against it. That includes timelines, guidance for Partners and Functional Leaders, calibration support, and sign-off with the Management Team / Partners Group. Advisory support: partner directly with Partners and Functional Leaders on individual pay decisions, such as new hire offers, promotions and retention cases. Your recommendations will be clear, defensible and grounded in the framework, not one-off improvisation. The future of reward at Unity: work with the CPO to shape how reward evolves as the firm grows, including the capability, capacity and structure we’ll need over time. We want reward that reflects how Unity actually works: Partner-led client teams, Functional Leader-led enablement teams, and a culture built on trust, direct feedback and progress over process. We don’t want a generic framework lifted from a larger, more traditional firm.

You’ll take what we have, judge what’s working and what isn’t, and build it out where it needs to go next. You’ll also run it: pay reviews, benefits renewals, and the data and reporting that keep it trusted. You’ll refine it each cycle and make sure the framework is well documented and easy for others to work with.

It suits someone who gets energy from building and improving, and who knows that reward only proves itself once it’s live. You’ll be comfortable with ambiguity and confident making judgement calls. You’ll respect what’s already been done while being willing to challenge it. You’ll also take satisfaction in the steady work of keeping a system accurate, fair and well-run.

This is a role where one expert can own reward end to end, without needing a full-time seat. It will suit an experienced reward specialist who wants a senior, high-impact role with a bounded commitment, including people with a fractional or portfolio background who now want a permanent home.


What you’ll own

  • Reward strategy and philosophy: build on and evolve Unity’s approach to pay. That covers how we position against the market, how pay works across client-facing and enablement tracks, and how reward reinforces Unity’s “progress over process” culture rather than working against it.

  • Pay structure and benchmarking: develop and maintain salary bands and grading across roles and levels, benchmarked against relevant professional services and advisory market data.

  • Pay review cycles: design and run the annual (or biannual) pay and bonus review. That includes timelines, guidance for Partners and Functional Leaders, calibration support, and sign-off with the Management Team / Partners Group.

  • Benefits: own the benefits offering end to end, including provider relationships, renewals, flexible benefits design and clear communication of value to employees.

  • Pay equity and compliance: run regular pay equity analysis (including gender pay gap reporting where applicable), keep Unity compliant with UK reward-related employment law, and flag risk to the CPO early.

  • Reward governance and data: keep reward data accurate and current in our people systems, and produce clear reporting for the Management Team on pay spend, equity and market position.

  • Advisory support: partner directly with Partners and Functional Leaders on individual pay decisions, such as new hire offers, promotions and retention cases. Your recommendations will be clear, defensible and grounded in the framework, not one-off improvisation.

  • The future of reward at Unity: work with the CPO to shape how reward evolves as the firm grows, including the capability, capacity and structure we’ll need over time.


What success looks like in your first 12 months

  • A refined, published pay and grading framework that Partners and Functional Leaders trust and actually use

  • A clean, well-governed annual pay review with no surprises for the Management Team

  • Reward decisions that are consistent, benchmarked and easy to explain, in keeping with Unity’s “trust and accountability” and “no surprises” principles

  • Reward documented and embedded, so that the framework is understood, easy to work with and keeps improving with each cycle


What we’re looking for

  • Senior reward / compensation and benefits experience, ideally including time in professional services, consulting or another partnership-style environment

  • Equally at home developing and extending an existing framework and running it well day to day, from benchmarking data and banding mechanics to benefits contracts and review timelines

  • Someone who sees the operational side of reward as part of the craft. Each pay cycle, renewal and equity report is a chance to test and improve the framework.

  • A pragmatic operator who can deliver across the full scope of reward in two focused days a week, prioritising the highest-leverage work first

  • Confident advising Partners and senior leaders directly, with recommendations grounded in evidence rather than precedent alone

  • Comfortable working with light process and high trust, building just enough structure and no more

  • Experience of part-time, interim or fractional working is welcome, but not required. We value people who can make an impact quickly and build things that last.


How this role fits at Unity

You’ll sit in the People Team, working closely with the Chief People Officer, the Performance Lead (a fellow part-time specialist), People Ops, and Partners and Functional Leaders across the business. Reward decisions at Unity draw on the same “collective insight, direct feedback” approach that runs through how the firm manages performance and probation. They’re calibrated and evidence-based, never made in isolation.

We are committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments or support when applying or arranging your interview.

We do not accept unsolicited CVs from third-party agencies.

Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today’s CFO, with connected solutions across finance, deals and tax. Focussed on client outcomes, seasoned experts lead every engagement, in an operating model powered by AI and free from audit conflict.

title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager
description: <p><strong>THE ROLE 📝</strong><br><br>We’re looking for a Senior Digital Marketing Manager to lead Form3’s digital growth and demand generation strategy, helping drive pipeline growth and brand development across our priority markets.&nbsp;Reporting to the Marketing Director, you’ll combine strategic ownership with execution across integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, digital acquisition and performance measurement. You’ll also identify practical ways to use AI, automation and marketing technology to improve targeting, personalisation, efficiency and campaign results. You’ll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product and the wider Marketing team, aligning marketing activity with commercial priorities and identifying opportunities within strategic accounts.<br><br><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and own Form3’s digital growth and demand generation strategy.</li> <li>Create go-to-market plans for products, propositions, markets and strategic announcements.</li> <li>Create integrated, multi-channel programmes that generate awareness, engagement, qualified leads and pipeline.</li> <li>Build account-based marketing programmes for high-value prospects and strategic accounts.</li> <li>Use AI, automation and marketing technology to improve targeting, personalisation, lead generation and campaign performance.</li> <li>Monitor performance across the marketing funnel and make insight-led recommendations.</li> <li>Improve website performance, conversion rates, user journeys and marketing-driven engagement.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>WE’RE LOOKING FOR 🔍</strong><br><br><strong>Essential</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years’ experience in B2B digital marketing, demand generation or campaign management.</li> <li>Strong experience developing campaign strategies and delivering integrated marketing campaigns.</li> <li>Proven ability to link marketing investment to revenue growth and return on investment.</li> <li>Expertise in account-based marketing, audience segmentation, pipeline generation and campaign activation.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI, automation and marketing technology to improve campaign performance.</li> <li>Strong digital marketing capability across websites, landing pages, email, paid media, search and social, with the breadth and depth to lead an integrated digital strategy.</li> <li>Strong analytical and performance-reporting skills, combined with a commercial and customer-focused approach.</li> <li>Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience within technology, SaaS, Fintech or payments.</li> <li>Experience working within a start-up/scale-up environment.</li> <li>Working experience across multiple markets e.g. UK/Europe/NA</li> <li>Familiarity with tooling such as Salesforce, Pardot, Salesloft, Cognism, ZoomInfo.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>INTERVIEW PROCESS ✍️</strong></p> <p><strong>Stage One:</strong> Screening Call with the Talent Team</p> <p><strong>Stage Two:</strong> Interview with Marketing Director</p> <p><strong>Stage Three:</strong> Case Study &amp; Presentation with Marketing Team</p> <p><strong>Stage Four: </strong>Interview with Head of Commercial Operations</p> <p>We always aim to stick to the above process; however, there may be occasions when an additional interview stage is required for us to be sure we are hiring the right person!</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>HIRING LOCATIONS 📍</strong></p> <p>Here are the locations that we are hiring from for this position:</p> <ul> <li>United Kingdom</li> </ul> <p>All new As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.</span></em></p></div><p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a highly technical Product Manager to own how developers discover, build on and grow with Telnyx.</p> <p>Telnyx operates a global infrastructure platform spanning communications, AI inference, GPUs, edge compute, databases and real-time applications. We've invested heavily in building the underlying infrastructure. Now we want to make it dramatically easier for developers to understand what's possible, build useful applications and get into production.</p> <p>This is a hands-on product role leading a small team of six engineers across Developer Relations and Product-Led Growth. We aren't looking for a traditional DevRel leader or someone whose primary skill is managing people. We want a strong engineer with excellent product judgment who understands developer experience, builds things personally and knows how to turn developer adoption into revenue.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Team</strong></p> <p>You'll lead a team of six: three DevRel engineers (sample apps, open source, technical content and demos) and three PLG engineers (activation, AI agents and automation, self-service conversion and expansion). You'll report to the Chief Operating Officer.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you'll own</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build applications developers actually want to use — Lead the DevRel team in building production-quality sample applications, integrations, templates and reference implementations on Telnyx. Publish them on GitHub, maintain them and make them easy for developers to deploy and extend. Turn those applications into compelling technical content, live demos and developer distribution.</li> <li>Drive product-led growth — Own the PLG operation responsible for moving developers from signup to meaningful usage and revenue. Use product telemetry, behavioral signals, AI agents and human intervention to identify friction, accelerate onboarding, improve conversion and expand self-service usage.</li> <li>Make the developer experience better — Get hands-on with our APIs, SDKs, documentation and infrastructure. Work directly with product engineering to identify and resolve the issues that make products difficult to use. Our reference applications should continuously test whether our products are genuinely ready for developers.</li> <li>Build AI-native growth systems — Work with Growth Engineering and RevOps to develop automated workflows for developer acquisition, onboarding, account intelligence, technical assistance and expansion. We believe small teams of excellent technical people supervising powerful automation can outperform much larger traditional GTM organizations.</li> <li>Connect the entire developer journey — Applications attract developers. Developers experiment with the platform. PLG helps them succeed. Production usage generates revenue. The feedback from that process improves our products and informs what we build next. You'll be accountable for making that system work. .</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>A strong software engineering background. You should be comfortable building and debugging real applications, working with APIs, reading code and understanding complex infrastructure.</li> <li>Experience as a Technical Product Manager, founding engineer, technical founder or similar role with substantial personal responsibility for shipping software.</li> <li>Exceptional product judgment, particularly around developer tools, APIs, documentation, onboarding and usability.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI infrastructure, LLMs, inference, cloud platforms, real-time systems or developer infrastructure.</li> <li>Understanding of product-led growth, including developer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention and monetization.</li> <li>Ability to work with AI coding agents, automation frameworks, product analytics and modern developer tooling.</li> <li>Strong technical communication skills. You can explain complicated technologies clearly and recognize what makes a useful demonstration or reference application.</li> <li>Comfortable leading a small technical team while remaining deeply involved in the actual work.</li> </ul> <p>Experience at a developer infrastructure company is valuable. Experience personally building and growing something developers love is more important.</p> <p><strong>How we'll measure success</strong></p> <p><strong>Your primary objective is growing developer-led revenue on Telnyx.</strong></p> <p>We'll look at activated developers, production applications deployed, self-service conversion, usage expansion and retention. We'll also measure the adoption of our reference applications, how effectively our developer content attracts users and how quickly developers can get from signup to a working application.</p> <p>We care about applications developers actually use, not demos shipped for the sake of demos. We care about developers reaching production, not just generating signups. And we care about revenue, not vanity metrics.</p> <p><strong>Who will thrive here</strong></p> <p>Someone who would rather build a working prototype than spend a week debating a roadmap. Someone who notices a broken onboarding experience and immediately starts fixing it. Someone who understands both what makes infrastructure technically excellent and what makes developers want to use it.</p> <p>You should be capable of leading six very technical people because you have the engineering ability, product instincts and judgment to make everyone around you more effective.</p> <p><strong>This is a builder's job, not a professional management job.</strong></p> <p>We're looking for someone who can make Telnyx a platform developers genuinely love building on, and turn that into a meaningful business.</p> <h6><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-RH1</span></h6><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>Location:</strong> Bristol, UK<br><strong>Salary:</strong> £45,000 per annum&nbsp;<br><strong>Start date: </strong>September 2027<br><strong>Application deadline</strong>: Midnight, 29th November 2026&nbsp;<br><em>We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline.</em></p> <h3>The Graduate Programme at Graphcore</h3> <p>Join Graphcore in a permanent role and start your career with two years of hands-on learning. From day one, you’ll be trusted to take ownership, share your ideas and help shape what we’re creating. title: Customer Trust Specialist
description: About Us: Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI. About the role We're looking for a Customer Trust Specialist to join our London office and help run the customer-facing side of our trust program. Where our GRC team keeps the compliance engine running behind the scenes, you'll be one of the people customers actually interact with, turning our security, privacy, and AI-governance posture into accurate answers that earn trust. You'll handle security questionnaires end to end, help operate our trust automation platform, and support customer conversations across EMEA and beyond. This is a great fit for someone with solid security-review experience who wants to grow their scope at a fast-scaling AI company. What you'll do Handle security questionnaires end to end: intake, drafting, review, and delivery for customer security assessments, RFPs, and vendor evaluations, in whatever format they arrive (OneTrust, spreadsheets, portals, email), pulling in Security, Legal, or Engineering when an answer needs it. Operate our trust automation platform: use and help improve the system that generates answers from our governed knowledge base. Review output for accuracy, flag weak or incorrect answers, and help keep the guardrails from over-claiming. Keep the knowledge base current: update answers as the platform, certifications, and control environment change; ingest new evidence (SOC 2, ISO 27001/27701/42001, HIPAA, penetration tests); and flag stale facts before they reach a customer. Handle one-off customer requests: evidence requests, Trust Center access, point questions from account teams, and anything that doesn't fit a questionnaire but still shapes a customer's confidence. Support customer calls: join prospect and customer calls alongside Sales and Solutions to field security, privacy, and AI-safety questions, especially for UK and EMEA customers. Partner with the sales team from intake through close. Support contract reviews: work with Legal and Deal Desk on security and privacy terms in DPAs and MSAs, including UK GDPR and EU data-transfer questions; learn which positions are standard and which need escalation. Keep the program honest: follow the standing rules that protect us and our customers: state only our standard position, never reference another customer's ask or situation, and escalate anything that needs Legal, Security, or Engineering sign-off. Track program data: log knowledge-base gaps, recurring questions we can't answer well yet, and where automation is saving or costing time, and share findings with the team. Help maintain public trust artifacts: keep the Trust Center, security whitepapers, and supporting evidence current and aligned with what we actually do. How the role will grow As you build context on our platform and customers, you'll take on more ownership: Broader program ownership: lead specific parts of the program, such as a framework area, a slice of the knowledge base, or EMEA customer coverage. AI-assurance coverage: help extend the knowledge base to emerging standards like ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, and the EU AI Act. Cross-functional influence: work more closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Sales to make our security and AI-safety posture a differentiator rather than a checkbox. What we're looking for 3 to 5 years of experience in customer-facing security, trust, or GRC roles: security assurance, customer trust, vendor security review, security-focused sales engineering, or similar. Hands-on experience with security questionnaires and the customer security-review process across formats (CAIQ, SIG, custom spreadsheets, OneTrust and similar portals) and frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR/UK GDPR, NIST). Some exposure to contracts (DPAs, MSAs) and the ability to connect contract language to a company's actual security controls. Strong written communication; you can turn a control requirement into a clear, accurate answer, and you know the difference between answering a question and over-answering it. Working knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and SaaS architectures; comfortable discussing encryption, isolation, and data flows with technical buyers. Interest in trust automation and AI-assisted tooling, with an understanding that automation needs guardrails. A precise, detail-oriented mindset; you catch the answer that is almost right, and you treat a customer-facing representation as something that has to be true. A collaborative, low-ego approach, and good judgment about when to escalate rather than answer. Comfortable working with a US-based team, including some overlap with US Eastern hours. Bonus: familiarity with AI/ML platforms, LLM inference, or AI governance concepts (zero data retention, content guardrails, EU AI Act). Why Fireworks? Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving. Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally. Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results. Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation. Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

MDC RECRUTEMENT, cabinet de recrutement de référence dans la filière Datacenter, recherche pour son client, acteur reconnu et en développement, un INGÉNIEUR CVC H/F, spécialisé Datacenter, dans le cadre d’un remplacement.

 

Vos Missions

 

·       Concevoir, dimensionner et optimiser les installations CVC (HVAC) dédiées aux environnements Datacenter, dans le respect des standards de performance et de résilience.

·       Piloter les études thermiques, énergétiques et fonctionnelles, en coordination avec les équipes internes et les partenaires externes.

·       Assurer le suivi technique des projets, de la conception à la mise en service, en garantissant la conformité aux exigences opérationnelles.

·       Participer activement à l’amélioration continue des infrastructures (efficacité énergétique, fiabilité, capacité de refroidissement).

·       Analyser et résoudre les problématiques techniques, proposer des solutions adaptées et assurer un reporting clair des actions menées.

·       Contribuer à la rédaction des documents techniques : notes de calcul, spécifications, dossiers de conception, DOE.

·       Réaliser une veille technique sur les innovations CVC liées aux environnements critiques et aux enjeux d’efficacité énergétique.


Votre Profil

 

·       Formation Ingénieur en génie climatique et/ou énergétique et/ou électrique.

·       Expérience confirmée de 5 à 10 ans dans un rôle similaire en environnements techniques exigeants (Datacenter, industrie, hôpitaux, salles blanches…), acquise en bureau d'études techniques, au sein d'une ingénierie de maîtrise d'œuvre, chez un installateur spécialisé en CVC/P.

·       Solide maîtrise des systèmes de refroidissement : groupes froids, free-cooling, CRAH/CRAC, chillers, CTA, régulation…

·       Anglais souhaité.

·       Rigueur, sens du service, autonomie, capacité à travailler en transversalité et goût pour les environnements critiques à haute exigence technique et environnementale.

 

Autres éléments

 

·       Contrat : CDI – Temps plein.

·       Poste basé en Île-de-France.

·       Rémunération : à partir de 60 K€ brut annuel, selon profil et expérience.

Gérer les capacités et les moyens de production (équipements, matières et hommes) en fonction des prévisions de charges.

title: Ingénieur Systèmes, Réseaux et Cloud (H/F)
description: L'entreprise : Notre client est un groupe industriel international évoluant dans un environnement technique exigeant, où la fiabilité et la sécurité des infrastructures informatiques sont essentielles à la continuité de ses activités. Dans le cadre du développement de son organisation informatique, il recherche un Ingénieur Systèmes, Réseaux & Cloud (H/F), rattaché au Responsable des infrastructures Cloud et Réseaux. Votre mission : Vous prenez en charge l'administration, la maintenance, la sécurisation et l'évolution des infrastructures informatiques du groupe, dans un environnement multisite et international. Votre périmètre couvre trois grands domaines : Cloud et virtualisation : administration des environnements Microsoft Azure et Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), gestion des plateformes VMware (vSphere, ESXi, vCenter), des machines virtuelles, des sauvegardes et des solutions de reprise d'activité. Systèmes et réseaux : administration des serveurs Windows et Linux, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, gestion des réseaux LAN/WAN, VPN, VLAN, Wi-Fi et des équipements Cisco Meraki. Vous intervenez également sur les solutions de sécurité et les pare-feux Palo Alto Networks. Support et amélioration continue : vous répondez au support technique de niveaux 3, notamment auprès des équipes de sous-traitants, analysez les incidents complexes, identifiez leurs causes et mettez en œuvre des solutions durables. En lien avec les équipes opérationnelles, notamment sur un site industriel, vous veillez à la disponibilité des infrastructures et accompagnez les évolutions techniques. De formation supérieure en informatique, systèmes et réseaux ou équivalent, vous justifiez de 4 à 5 ans d'expérience minimum dans l'administration d'infrastructures systèmes, réseaux et Cloud. Vous disposez d'une solide expérience sur Microsoft Azure et VMware. Une pratique d'Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Cisco Meraki et Palo Alto Networks est attendue. Vous maîtrisez les environnements Windows/Linux et possédez de bonnes connaissances en sécurité, virtualisation et administration réseau. Une expérience en environnement industriel ou multisite sera appréciée. Au-delà de votre expertise technique, votre personnalité fera la différence. Nous recherchons un professionnel autonome, curieux et doté d'un véritable sens du service. Vous savez prendre du recul, analyser les problèmes dans leur globalité, identifier les causes plutôt que traiter uniquement les symptômes et surtout, aller au bout des sujets. Accessible, pédagogue et doté d'un bon relationnel, vous savez communiquer avec des interlocuteurs techniques comme opérationnels. Vous êtes force de proposition et aimez faire avancer les choses. Anglais courant indispensable : vous serez amené à échanger régulièrement avec des équipes internationales. Ce prérequis est obligatoire pour le poste. Des déplacements ponctuels en France et à l'international sont à prévoir. Les conditions Poste basé à Bordeaux (33) Si vous êtes intéressés, merci de candidater en cliquant sur « postuler ». Technology is what we do. Passion is what sets us apart.

 At ITQ, we partner with some of the world's leading brands to unlock the full potential of Cloud Native, Cloud Infrastructure, Private AI, Managed Services and Project Management. But technology is only part of the story.

We believe the best results come from people who are curious, driven and passionate about what they do. That's why we give you the freedom to grow, the trust to shape your own path and the opportunity to make a real impact.

How you’ll make your impact

ITQ is growing in Belgium, France and Luxembourg. To support this growth, we are strengthening our marketing presence in the region and are looking for a Local Marketing Lead for ITQ Gallia. You will turn the strategy and campaigns of our central marketing team into local actions. These actions build ITQ's brand and generate qualified leads for our sales teams, across all our propositions: Hybrid Cloud, Private AI, Cloud Native, Digital Workspace and managed services. You start with a limited set of priority propositions, agreed with the Gallia sales team.

 

You will report to the Managing Director of ITQ Gallia and work hand in hand with the local sales team. You are a hands-on B2B marketer who likes to get things done. You enjoy working closely with sales colleagues and with enthusiastic, dynamic teams in the ITQ Family. 

 

What you’ll be doing

The top three tasks for the first year will be : 

  • Organize local events (breakfasts, roundtables, meetups) and ITQ's presence at partner and community events (Red Hat, VMware Explore, VMUG, Omnissa…). You hand over every lead to sales and track the follow-up. 

  • Set up co-marketing with our vendors (Broadcom, Dell, Red Hat, SUSE, Omnissa…) and manage vendor marketing funds. 

  • Select and manage local agencies and suppliers (videographers, translators, event partners, merchandise), in line with ITQ's brand guidelines. 

 

On the long term, the following tasks will also be expected from the Local Marketing Lead : 

  • Build the region's annual marketing plan, aligned with ITQ's central themes and with Gallia's sales objectives. You prioritize actions, manage the local budget and track results. 

  • Translate ITQ's central ideal customer profiles and key messages to the local market per country, and collect local proof points (customer cases, references). 

  • Adapt our central marketing team's campaign kits, written in English, into French. You also maintain the local part of the ITQ website and produce customer cases with the sales and project management teams and LinkedIn content. 

  • Run inbound and outbound campaigns (SEO, webinars, emailing, LinkedIn, nurturing). With the sales team, you follow up on buying signals from target accounts. 

 

Who you are

Must-have 

  • You have 7+ years of experience in B2B marketing, including at least 3 years in operational or field marketing, ideally in the IT sector (integrator, IT services company, MSP or software vendor). 

  • You can run demand generation and account-based marketing campaigns from start to finish. 

  • You are comfortable with marketing automation and CRM tools, LinkedIn (organic and Ads) and the basics of SEO. 

  • You know how to organize events and webinars. 

  • You work autonomously, focus on results and keep a close eye on KPIs and budget. 

  • You enjoy working with salespeople and know how to bring suppliers and partners together. 

  • You are a native French speaker with excellent written and spoken English. 

 

Nice-to-have 

  • Ideally, you live near one of our offices in Luxembourg (Mamer), Belgium (Leuven) or France (Paris), and you are willing to travel regularly across the three countries. 

  • Experience across several countries. 

  • Dutch language skills. 

  • Experience with co-marketing and vendor marketing funds (MDF). 

 

We offer some awesome perks

Because when passionate people thrive, everyone benefits.

 

At ITQ, we believe that when people have the freedom to grow, the support to develop and the opportunity to follow their passions, they do their best work. That's why we've created an environment where you can thrive; professionally and personally.

  • Tailored learning & development: No traditional performance reviews. Instead, you’ll have continuous conversations, training and certification opportunities to help you become the very best at what you do.

  • A community of experts: Join a team of passionate professionals who genuinely enjoy sharing knowledge, supporting one another and celebrating success together.

  • Collective bonus: Success is something we achieve together. That's why everyone shares in our success through a collective annual bonus.

  • Mobility that works for you: Whether you prefer a lease car or a mobility budget, you'll have the flexibility to choose the option that best fits your lifestyle.

  • The right tools from day one: Choose your own laptop and phone with our budget equipment, delivered before you start. We also provide a home office budget to help you create your ideal workspace.

  • ITQlife: We organize activities throughout the year that bring colleagues together: from our traditional summer BBQ to our annual weekend and various team outings.

  • Your well-being matters: You’ll have access to a vitality coach, who can support you with your psychical and mental well-being.

  • And of course… we offer a solid foundation by offering a competitive salary, insurances and a pension plan.

Alan operates in 8 countries.

This role is based in France and covers French employment and labour law.

You will join the People team, work closely with the People Compliance owner, the People lead and the individual situations crew, and be mentored by Alan's Compliance Key Function on how we practise legal topics at Alan.

It is a generalist team: everyone shares core missions, including individual situation management and HRBP responsibilities. Then each person owns one or more cross-functional topics depending on their flavour. In your case: French employment and labour law.

Your missions

On top of the core missions shared across the People team, you will work on a diverse range of high-impact topics:

  • Employment law expertise: be the go-to person on French individual and collective employment law, with a strong focus on working time, night work and on-call rules (astreinte, rest periods), where the rules are strict and a creative, well-grounded approach makes a difference.

  • Legal watch: monitor French labour-law changes, flag what matters for Alan, and use AI agents for legal watch and ongoing compliance checks.

  • Obligations register: turn obligations into simple tools and processes, tracked in a register.

  • Health and safety at work.

  • Audits and inspections: support labour inspections, URSSAF audits and the related compliance reporting.

  • Social dialogue: support the People lead in preparing CSE information-consultations, running the 2027 social elections, and drafting and updating company agreements (working time, profit-sharing, agreements for new services).

  • AI and automation: use them to multiply the impact of your work.

  • You have contributed to a live CSE topic (e.g. preparing an information-consultation) and to at least one other live topic (e.g. working-time or on-call policy, an agreement for a new service).

  • You have shadowed and been reverse-shadowed on individual situation management.

By 5 months

  • You own CSE information-consultations end to end, and a workstream such as a company agreement, with the crew as a sounding board.

  • You are involved in preparing the 2027 social elections.

  • You handle French individual situations without supervision, including the legal analysis.

  • A first legal-watch automation is running.

  • Crew members and leads come to you as the go-to expert on French employment law.

  • You have around 4+ years of hands-on experience applying French employment law, typically in a law firm (ideally international), or you are a lawyer who has already moved into a People role.

  • You are AI-enthusiastic: you already use AI in your daily work and stay critical of the output.

  • You show judgement and discretion with confidential information and sensitive human situations.

  • Experience in the health sector, insurance, a regulated environment or a scale-up.

  • M&A or reorganisation experience.

  • Exposure to other jurisdictions (Belgium, Spain).

Level range

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0 - D level range.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Key Account Management Team


Our Account Management team’s purpose is to make our key accounts stay and grow with Alan. We created the team in 2020 and we are now 30+.
We are looking for amazing people to help us take care of our growing pipe on Public Sector accounts (Ministries and other public entities).
Being a Key Account Manager at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate experts, with different backgrounds.
We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?


As a Key Account Manager, you will:

  • Handle a portfolio of strategic accounts in the Public Sector

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships with key stakeholders and display a customer-centric approach to identify the main needs and allow our clients to achieve their goals through Alan

  • Proactively identify potential signals of dissatisfaction and implement solutions to answer them

  • Ensure successful onboarding of new accounts and promote Alan health partner positioning to generate massive adoption by employees and admins

  • Analyze and present consumption reports to customers through business reviews

  • Identify and execute out-of-the-box initiatives to engage our existing customers

  • Renegotiate contracts to guarantee both great value for money to our customers and sustainable profitability

  • Participate in the evolution of our products and services, acting as the voice of our customers when discussing with Product teams

You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • You have at least 6 years of experience in a customer-facing role including frequent interactions with C-Levels

  • You have full working proficiency in French (excellent oral and written communication)

  • You have at least advanced level in English

  • You are experienced in dealing with very large organizations and potentially with unions

  • You have the tact and empathy that make great negotiators

  • You are an expert in positive lobbying with key stakeholders and create long-term relationship based on trust and transparency

  • You are very analytical, very comfortable with presenting deep data analysis to clients and solving complex problems

  • You have great active listening skills and are a master in the art of crafting the right follow-up message

  • You have a growth mindset: you are able to adapt to new trends and to develop an in-depth understanding of the health insurance market

  • You are currently based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux or Marseille.


It is nice to have a previous experience in Insurance or any industry linked to benefits. Having experience with or within the Public Sector space is also a nice to have.


For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-E level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Bordeaux or Marseille.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your  time as you  wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly  flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

raw.description:
